tess: Quick ping  Saturday LAN update: bringing tabletop, PS5, Switch, and snacks. Need a few adapters and a HDMI splitter. Anyone?

omar: Ive got an HDMI splitter and 2 USB-C->HDMI dongles. Also a box of mixed cookies.

viv: Bringing two wired controllers and a portable router for a clean LAN. I can also bring a roll of gaffer tape for cables.

kai: I can bring a spare OLED Switch dock, but its missing the HDMI cable. Also have a Pro Controller.

tess: Ops-bot said mezzanine D is reserved 6:30-11:00. Can people reply with what theyre bringing so we dont duplicate?

omar: HDMI splitter, USB-C dongles, cookies.

viv: Router, 2 wired pads, tape.

kai: Dock + pro controller.

meme-bot: PSA: LABEL YOUR CONTROLLERS OR THEY WILL WALK AWAY :laughing: :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:

tess: Also doing a tiny poll: React with emoji for priority games: :car: Mario Kart, :crossed_swords: Smash, :joystick: Tekken, :game_die: Jackbox

omar: :car: :crossed_swords:

viv: :game_die:

kai: :crossed_swords:

ops-bot: Facilities note: please return chairs to stack after event. Recycling bins provided.

tess: Great. If anyone can bring a 2m HDMI cable and an extra power strip thatd help. See yall Saturday :)
